import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd
import polars as pl

@nw.narwhals
def add_total(df):
    return df.with_columns(
        total=nw.col("price") * nw.col("quantity")
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pdf = pd.DataFrame({"price": [10, 20, 30], "quantity": [2, 3, 1]})
    plf = pl.DataFrame({"price": [10, 20, 30], "quantity": [2, 3, 1]})
    
    print("Pandas:")
    print(add_total(pdf))
    print("\nPolars:")
    print(add_total(plf))
